sources.entry: agenttrace - Open-source local TUI observability for AI coding agents. Tracks cost, tokens, latency, failures, health, anomalies, reports, and CI gates across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Aider, Cursor exports, and more.

summary.one_liner: agenttrace is a local-first terminal TUI and report generator that reads AI coding-agent session logs to show cost, tokens, time, and slow-run diagnosis.
summary.what_it_does: It parses session history from many coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Qwen Code, Cline, Aider, Cursor exports, Hermes Agent, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Pi, Oh My Pi, Kimi CLI, Copilot-style logs, and generic JSON/JSONL traces) without sending data off the machine. It ranks sessions by cost, duration, turns, health, failures, anomalies, model, source, or text search. It reports token usage (input, output, cache), estimated cost, latency, long gaps, hanging sessions, retry loops, slow tools, and context pressure. A single binary opens the TUI or prints CLI output such as --sessions and --overview, and it can write JSON, Markdown, and self-contained HTML reports. Governance reports cover cost audit with pricing fallbacks, prioritized recommendations, observed MCP invocations, context and cache trends, and heuristic Git commit correlation.
use_cases: compare what multiple coding agents spent
diagnose why an AI agent task ran slowly
find expensive or failing agent sessions
generate shareable cost and session reports
gate CI on agent session metrics
audit token usage and estimated pricing
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | sh  (macOS/Linux install script; URL missing from README)
notable: Local-first: prompts, code, and logs stay on the machine with no hosted backend
Honest capability levels (Detailed, Aggregate, Limited) per session so partial traces are not presented as complete
Privacy-safe tool steps: stores metadata and durations, not prompt, response, or argument bodies
Governance reports with pricing overrides via a local JSON file and explicit estimate/heuristic labeling
Update command verifies SHA-256 checksum before replacing the binary
caveats: Cost figures are estimates, not provider billing; Git delivery correlation is heuristic and does not prove a commit reached main
Loaded-server MCP coverage is reported as unavailable unless the source log records it
Install scripts for macOS/Linux and Windows are listed, but the README's install URLs are blank in this text
keywords: track what my ai agents spent
